name: HOOK
detail: Hook stated immediately: pluck + celesta over filtered supersaw, sub swell

name: MOMENTUM
detail: Kick, clap and rolling sidechained bass enter; hook repeats

name: BUILD
detail: Strings, horn counter-line, 16th hats, arp and supersaw lead join; stop-time stabs in bar 16

name: BREAKDOWN
detail: Drums drop; piano + choir; Neapolitan Eb chord; timpani roll and riser; silent 8th before drop

name: CLIMAX
detail: Full band: supersaw lead, brass counter-line, choir, big drums; C-D tom lift

name: FINALE
detail: Hook returns a whole step higher in E minor

name: ENDING
detail: Final E-major hit (Picardy third) and decay to silence

name: Impact + hook downbeat
detail: Title card / first frame. Hook is the brand: put the logo or character reveal here.

name: Kick + bass drop in
detail: First action beat / character starts moving.

name: Crash: BUILD begins
detail: Scene change; new layer of the story.

name: Tom fill
detail: Optional small visual accent (camera push).

name: Stop-time stab 1
detail: Three synced band hits (bar 16): ideal for 3 quick cuts / punch-ins.

name: Impact + downlifter: BREAKDOWN
detail: Emotional turn / problem revealed. Low density: best narration window.

name: Neapolitan Eb chord + tremolo swell
detail: Tension rises; slow zoom.

name: Silent 8th note
detail: Freeze frame / blackout before the reveal.

name: DROP: crash + sub drop + timpani
detail: Main reveal / hero moment. Strongest sync point.

name: Crash: climax phrase 2
detail: Second big action beat.

name: Tom lift C-D begins
detail: Run-up / montage acceleration.

name: Key change to E minor
detail: Final push / payoff scene.

name: Tom fill
detail: Lead-in to end card.

name: Final E-major hit
detail: End card / logo slam. Tail decays to silence at 60.0 s.
